d:
The Indian Parliament may resume proceedings in both Houses following a request from the Central Government. Union Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju has said that the government has requested the Lok Sabha Speaker and the Rajya Sabha Chairman to reconvene the two Houses.
As per the proposed schedule, the Lok Sabha meeting may be held on November 30, while the Rajya Sabha meeting has been requested for December 2. Both Houses may conclude their proceedings on December 3.
